name: season-ramp-uk-mid
description: Rest-season weight at about 55 N (UK) on 2026-10-17: halfway up the 30 day ramp, so 0.5.
why: Full rest is 60 days either side of 31 December at 55 N (1 November to the end of February), reached by a 30 day linear ramp. 31 December minus 17 October is 75 days: weight = 1 - (75 - 60) / 30 = 0.5. Hand computation.
